title: PARTONOMY: Large Multimodal Models with Part-Level Visual Understanding

layout.note: Left column of three stacked task cards, two green cards side by side at the top right, a wide mutation card under them with the legend in its corner, and a full-width strip of ten part-mask thumbnails along the bottom edge.

lesson: Show a benchmark's task families as small tinted chat cards, one real question and answer on a photo per card, with the key words in bold italic and the matching mask painted on the picture; group cards by tint and give data construction one extra card beside them.
